description: An audit-style notice with three independent problems on three claims: a duplicated office-visit line on the cardiology claim, a 20% coinsurance on a laboratory test that should be $0, and a claim total that overstates the patient's share by $20. Use it to score recall when several error kinds appear on one document.

sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 1 §120, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf

sources.what: No deductible or coinsurance on laboratory fee schedule tests
